description: Open or join the selected serial device and request control. If another client controls it, join read-only and report the actual baudrate. The first opener chooses the baudrate; reconnect explicitly to reacquire control.

baudrate.description: Requested rate if this call opens the device; an existing connection keeps its actual rate.

name: connect

description: Describe supported Linux and U-Boot transfer methods, limits, prerequisites, and verification. Human input remains unrestricted and may interleave with a transfer; coordinate before starting operations that require an idle console.
name: file_transfer_capabilities

description:
Upload a local binary file to Linux storage or an explicit U-Boot RAM address.

Linux uses
base64 over a shell and verifies target size plus SHA-256 before installation,
using target sha256sum when it passes a known-output probe or OpenSSL dgst as
fallback. U-Boot uses `loady <address>` (YMODEM CRC); target_path is the
transfer filename and address is required. U-Boot RAM is read back and
compared. The operation never flashes or executes the image. Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.

address.description: Required explicit hexadecimal RAM address for U-Boot; no default.

local_path.description: Path to a local file readable by this MCP server process.

max_bytes.description: Maximum accepted file size, at most 8 MiB.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced (Linux only).

prompt_regex.description: U-Boot prompt regex; otherwise use the configured prompt pattern.

target_path.description: Linux destination path, or a simple ASCII YMODEM filename on U-Boot.

name: upload_file

description:
Download a Linux filesystem path or explicit U-Boot RAM range to a local file.

Linux requires
`base64` and a working `sha256sum` or OpenSSL `dgst -sha256`. U-Boot uses
textual `md.b`, not an assumed serial-send command, and requires explicit address, length, and an
anchored prompt regex. U-Boot dump verification is limited to exact byte
count and sequential address rows (no checksum is available). Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.

address.description: Required explicit hexadecimal U-Boot RAM address; no default.

length.description: Required U-Boot byte length; bounded by max_bytes.

local_path.description: Local destination path; an existing file requires overwrite=true.

max_bytes.description: Maximum accepted transfer size, at most 8 MiB.

overwrite.description: Whether the local destination may be replaced.

prompt_regex.description: U-Boot prompt regex; otherwise use the configured prompt pattern.

name: download_file

description: Leave this client's membership of the selected port. Other participants and connected devices are unaffected.
name: disconnect

description:
Send text bytes to the serial port and return output observed after the send.

Completion uses terminator_regex (or the connection default prompt_regex) when supplied;
otherwise it returns after output has been quiet for idle_timeout, bounded by timeout.
line_ending is explicit: none, lf, cr, or crlf. Data already buffered before this call is
preserved for read_output; this call consumes only bytes received after its send point. Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.

encoding.description: Text encoding for the serial stream.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of silence that ends the wait.

line_ending.description: One of none, lf, cr, crlf.

max_lines.description:
Return at most this many lines, keeping the *last* ones where
the prompt/result/error lives and noting how many earlier lines were
dropped. Use it to avoid pulling large boot banners or repetitive log
spew into context. 0 (the default) returns everything. Ignored for
hex/raw needs — raise it or use view_io(direction="rx") instead.

timeout.description: Overall cap in seconds for waiting on output.

name: send_command

description:
Consume and return buffered/asynchronously arriving serial output.

If timeout is 0, returns currently buffered data immediately. If timeout is positive,
waits for data and then for idle_timeout of silence, never exceeding timeout. Uses this client's independent cursor and does not acquire or renew control.

encoding.description: Text encoding for the serial stream.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of silence that ends the wait.

max_lines.description:
Return at most this many lines, keeping the *last* ones and
noting how many earlier lines were dropped. Useful when the buffer has
accumulated boot or log noise you do not need in context. 0 (the
default) returns everything.

name: read_output

description: Discard all currently buffered serial output. Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.
name: clear_output

description: Set or clear the default regex terminator used by send_command. Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.
name: set_prompt_pattern

description:
List known bootloader-entry profiles (builtin + user-defined).

User profiles live in ~/.config/serial-mcp/profiles.json; credentials are
stored separately in ~/.config/serial-mcp/credentials.json (mode 0600) and
are never displayed.
name: list_boot_profiles

description:
Store device login credentials locally for use by enter_bootloader.

Credentials are written to ~/.config/serial-mcp/credentials.json with mode
0600 (outside any repo). They are redacted from logs and view_io transcripts.

password.description: Login password (stored locally only; redacted in logs).

profile_key.description:
Key that profiles reference via login.password_ref (or the
profile name itself).

name: set_boot_credentials

description:
Log in to the device's shell console (no reboot, no bootloader entry).

Credentials resolve like enter_bootloader's: explicit arguments win, else the
profile's login section, else the local credentials file. The password is
always written through the redacting path, so it never reaches the log file
or the view_io transcript — prefer a profile + set_boot_credentials over
passing a secret as an argument. Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.

encoding.description: Text encoding for the serial stream.

login_mode.description:
"auto" detects the login/password prompts; "blind" types
Enter, username, password on a schedule, for consoles flooded with
unsolicited logging where prompt detection reads noise.

overall_timeout.description: Wall-clock cap in seconds for the whole login.

password.description:
Explicit password (overrides profile/credentials; prefer stored
credentials so the secret stays out of call arguments).

profile.description:
Profile whose login section provides username/password_ref
(see list_boot_profiles).

name: login

description:
Enter the device's U-Boot bootloader automatically.

Flow: optionally log in (if the device sits at a login prompt), reboot,
wait for the autoboot window, then send interrupt keys at a paced interval
until the bootloader prompt appears. Never loops forever: attempts are
capped and the whole operation has a wall-clock timeout. Requires current control. If control is lost or expired, call connect(port, baudrate) explicitly; this call never acquires control.

abort_regex.description:
Regex indicating the device booted fully (e.g. "Login:") —
triggers another login+reboot cycle instead of endless tapping.

delay.description: Seconds to wait after reboot before tapping begins.

encoding.description: Text encoding for the serial stream.

interrupt_keys.description:
Characters to tap during the autoboot window, e.g. [" "].
Sent repeatedly; each key is tried max_attempts times.

interval.description:
Seconds between interrupt key taps (pacing protects the RX
buffer — flooding can cause dropped characters in U-Boot).

login_mode.description:
"auto" detects prompts and falls back to blind typing;
"blind" skips all prompt verification and fires Enter, username,
password on a fixed schedule. Use "blind" on consoles flooded with
unsolicited logging, where prompt detection reads noise.

login_password.description:
Explicit password (overrides profile/credentials;
prefer set_boot_credentials so secrets stay out of logs).

max_attempts.description: Hard cap on interrupt keys per pass.

overall_timeout.description: Wall-clock cap in seconds for the entire operation.

profile.description:
Named boot profile (see list_boot_profiles). Provides defaults
for everything below.

reboot.description:
Whether to issue the reboot command first (False = device is
already cycling / power-cycled externally).

reboot_command.description: Shell command to reboot (default from profile or "reboot").

success_regex.description: Regex indicating the bootloader prompt was reached.

name: enter_bootloader

description:
View recent serial I/O (tio-style timestamped TX/RX transcript).

Shows what was sent to the device ([TX:ai] by the AI, [TX:user] by human participants) and what came back ([RX]). direction filters to tx, rx, or
all. hex_mode shows raw bytes in hex like tio --hex.

hex_mode.description: Render payloads as hex instead of text.

lines.description: Maximum number of records to show (most recent first-tail).

name: view_io

description: List available serial ports with descriptions (like tio --list).
name: list_serial_ports

description: Change the baudrate of a connected device. Requires current control; applies to all participants immediately.

baudrate.description: New baudrate accepted by the serial driver.

name: set_baudrate
